d: Kiran Rao shares her thoughts on meaningful cinema, storytelling, acting, and theatre in this engaging episode of ‘Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra’. From films like Laapataa Ladies, Dangal, PK, Delhi Belly, and Taare Zameen Par to her unique approach to directing actors and rehearsals, the conversation offers deep insights into Bollywood filmmaking and creative storytelling. Kiran Rao also talks about why theatre remains her first love, how stories bring people together, and why cinema should entertain without feeling like a lecture.
